```lean
intro n
let τ' := Complex.I * τ
let z := Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * τ')
let z_mod := Complex.abs z
have h1 : Complex.abs (Complex.exp (↑Real.pi * τ')) = Real.exp (Real.pi * Complex.im τ') :=
  Complex.abs_exp_real_im
have h2 : Complex.im τ' = ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im :=
  by simp [τ', Complex.im, Complex.I, Real.pi, Complex.mul]
have h3 : Real.pi * Complex.im τ' = Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im :=
  by simp [h2]
have h4 : Real.exp (Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im) = Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im) ^ ↑n.natAbs :=
  by rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_mul, Real.pow_mul, Real.pow_zero, Real.one_mul]
have h5 : Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs = Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs) :=
  by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.pow_mul]
have h6 : Real.exp (Real.pi * ↑n ^ 2 * τ.im) ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n.natAbs) :=
  by rw [h4, h5]; exact Real.exp_le_of_le (by linarith)
exact h6
```
